body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/37369
Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/978

## What I did

Reproduced the GLM5 fused MLA loader bug against base 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365 with a deterministic iterator that exposes two marked tensor views backed by one reusable RunAI-style staging buffer. The q-first case loaded [3, 4, 3, 4] instead of [1, 2, 3, 4], and the independent kv-first case loaded [1, 2, 1, 2].

The loader now clones only RunAI-marked tensors that it retains in the q_a_proj / kv_a_proj_with_mqa cache across iterator advancement. The marker and ownership helper are shared with existing DeepSeek retention paths. Added regression coverage for both arrival orders and an unmarked independently allocated boundary case.

## Reproduce and validate

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-86b2d144d98a/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/models/test_glm5_next_weight_loading.py test/registered/unit/model_loader/test_runai_model_streamer_loader.py
```

Result after the fix: 14 passed. Repository pre-commit hooks also passed, including isort, ruff, ruff-format, codespell, Python AST, and CI registry validation.

A synthetic numerical check ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950). The fixed loader preserved the expected fused weight, and an exact GPU matrix multiplication produced [0, 2, 4, 6], matching an independently constructed expected tensor. Evidence and commands are retained under reports/j-86b2d144d98a/.

## Limitations

GLM-5.3-Flash and draft-model weights were unavailable. I did not run a full-model FP8 generation/semantic-accuracy test or reproduce the distributed TP=8, DFLASH, Kubernetes, streamer-concurrency-8, or multi-node deployment. The deterministic fixture validates the reported ownership mechanism and GPU use of the resulting weight only. No native code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
